This is an incredibly hard situation, and it makes sense that you feel torn between caring for your partner and protecting yourself. Please know that you can do both—caring about someone doesn't mean you're responsible for keeping them alive, and setting boundaries isn't what causes a person to harm themselves.

When someone mentions suicide, it's important to take it seriously. If you believe they're in immediate danger, contact emergency services (911 in the US) or a crisis line like 988 (US) where you can also get guidance on how to respond. At the same time, threats used to prevent you from taking space aren't something you can safely manage alone—their safety ultimately requires professional support, not your constant availability.

You deserve support too. Consider reaching out to a therapist for yourself, and remember you're allowed to step away, rest, and set limits. You matter in this, and taking care of yourself isn't a betrayal of them.
